Same faces and clothing as reference. Warm wooden treatment room, cool moonlight window, low table with a SMALL WHITE CERAMIC MEDICINE BOTTLE AND ROUND BROWN WOODEN STOPPER, cotton pads and brass kettle. Minor clean non-graphic wound is on his UPPER BACK near shoulder, never chest. General is deadpan and dignified, NEVER leering, exaggerated smiling or mugging. Woman tries to act professionally but her gestures betray her distraction. Non-explicit lighthearted wound-care comedy. ACTUAL continuous character animation with walking, turning, reaching, restrained reactions and coherent hands. Multiple planned camera setups, clean motivated cuts, stable anatomy and identity. Keep camera on same side of action axis; no mirror reversal. Do not remain locked to reference framing. ONLY speak the exact Mandarin lines quoted below, ONCE each, in order. Natural low adult male voice and bright adult female voice, clear lip sync, only current speaker moves lips, NO other speech or narration. No humming, chanting, singing, background dialogue or English words. Room ambience and subtle foley ONLY, NO background music. NO written text, captions, logos or watermarks. Exactly 12 seconds.

scenes.prompt: Shot A, 0-3s: side-profile medium-wide showing seated shirtless general and woman behind him; she holds a clean cotton pad, circles around the end of the bench toward his front with two small steps, pretending to inspect his uninjured upper arm. Camera gently tracks sideways with her, show actual feet and sleeve movement, no fast spinning. Shot B, 3-7.5s: three-quarter medium closeup of his face and shoulders, eyes follow her while body remains still; he asks dryly, exactly: ‘你这药，怎么擦了半个时辰？’ Shot C, 7.5-12s: over HIS shoulder looking toward her face, she straightens, raises the cotton pad like a serious clinician, and replies with exaggerated confidence: ‘伤势严重，必须仔细检查！’ His near shoulder frames foreground; she ends looking professionally serious. The white medicine bottle remains CLOSED on the table. No medicine is poured or applied yet.
captions: 你这药，怎么擦了半个时辰？
伤势严重，必须仔细检查！

scenes.prompt: Start with woman now standing in FRONT of seated general, same bench and room. Shot A, 0-4.5s: reverse over HER clothed shoulder, general in three-quarter view. He calmly points one thumb toward his own upper back and says exactly: ‘可我的伤在背上。’ Shot B, 4.5-7s: cut to woman's face; she freezes mid-nod, eyes flick sideways, her flame hair briefly shrinks to a tiny embarrassed crown. Hold a short silent comedy beat. Shot C, 7-12s: medium side two-shot; she takes half a step sideways, lifts one finger with sudden inspiration, and answers briskly: ‘胸前也要预防感染！’ She does NOT touch his chest. He lowers his pointing hand and silently watches her, expression perfectly deadpan. Bottle stays closed on table. Only TWO specified lines.

Shot A, 0-2s: medium two-shot from slightly above the table; woman still stands in front of general, proudly holding cotton pad. He silently looks down at the table, then extends his index finger toward a SMALL CLOSED WHITE CERAMIC MEDICINE BOTTLE with round brown wooden stopper. Shot B, 2-7s: cut to his handsome deadpan face, same low voice, he says exactly once: ‘那你倒是先把药瓶打开。’ He holds eye contact calmly. Shot C, 7-9s: clear close-up insert of the untouched medicine bottle; wooden stopper visibly seals it. Her hand enters frame and cautiously picks it up. Shot D, 9-12s: cut to her face and bottle held at chest height, she looks from stopper to him; embarrassed blinking, lips pressed closed, flame hair rises in a tiny startled puff. General remains silent in soft background. No other dialogue or vocal reaction. The visual reveal of the STILL CLOSED bottle is the punchline.
captions: 那你倒是先把药瓶打开。

scenes.prompt: Shot A, 0-4s: waist-up side two-shot. Woman holds white medicine bottle with both hands and makes ONE unsuccessful gentle tug on its brown wooden stopper; her sleeve slips over her fingers, she pulls sleeve back, comically flustered but silent. Seated general extends hand; she hands him the bottle naturally. Shot B, 4-6s: close-up on HIS hands, one hand holds bottle steady, other pulls stopper out cleanly; no extra fingers. Shot C, 6-9s: medium shot; he gives her the opened bottle, holds detached stopper clearly in his other hand, and asks calmly: ‘这下，可以上药了？’ Shot D, 9-12s: she quickly nods and replies: ‘可以！我很专业的。’ She steps back beside his UPPER BACK, ready with cotton pad, deliberately professional posture; he faces forward with a barely perceptible raised eyebrow. The bottle is now open, stopper remains on the table. End on a readable medium two-shot of both adult faces for the animated end card. No additional speech.
